trip.title: Japan & Vietnam
trip.subtitle: Snow to the South China Sea

legs.title: Brisbane to Osaka
legs.body: Arrive Kansai. Haruka Express to Kyoto Station, 1h15, runs every 30 minutes. Reserve seats.

legs.title: Kyoto
legs.body: Higashiyama on foot, Arashiyama early to beat the coaches, Fushimi Inari at dawn or dusk. Nishiki Market and one kaiseki dinner as the food anchors. Kyoto snows a handful of days a year, so late December is luck rather than plan.

spots.title: Fushimi Inari Taisha
spots.body: Empty before 8am and after dark. Full circuit is about two hours.

spots.title: Nishiki Market
spots.body: Closes early on some days over New Year. Check before going.

legs.title: Kyoto to Nozawa Onsen
legs.body: Kyoto to Tokyo 2h15 on the Tokaido Shinkansen. Change at Tokyo Station for Iiyama, 1h40 on the Hokuriku Shinkansen. Iiyama to Nozawa by Liner bus, 25 minutes.

legs.title: Nozawa Onsen
legs.body: A working onsen village rather than a resort. Thirteen free public bathhouses scattered through the streets, steam coming up through the snowbanks. Four to five metres of snow through winter and no lift pass required. Consider splitting two nights here with two at Madarao.

stays.title: Yama Lodge Madarao
stays.subtitle: 12-room lodge, two private onsen
stays.body: Madarao Kogen, 30 minutes from Iiyama. Fire pit lounge, proper drying room, breakfast included, shuttle that drops you at restaurants and collects you. No on-site restaurant, so book dinners early over Christmas week.

stays.title: Ryokan Tsuchi to Ito
stays.subtitle: 150-year kominka, one group per day
stays.body: Not actually in Nozawa. It's in Omi village, 45 minutes from Matsumoto or Nagano and 1h45 from Nozawa. Goemon-buro, farm-to-table from their own organic plot. Would need its own two nights slotted between Kyoto and Nozawa.

legs.title: Nozawa Onsen to Tokyo
legs.body: Bus to Iiyama 25 minutes, then Hokuriku Shinkansen to Tokyo 1h40.

legs.title: Tokyo
legs.body: New Year here. Japan has no NYE fireworks, so the night is joya no kane, temple bells rung 108 times, then hatsumode the following morning. Three nights is short, so pick two or three neighbourhoods rather than a checklist.

spots.title: Zojoji Temple
spots.body: Balloon release at midnight with Tokyo Tower lit behind it. The closest thing Tokyo has to a spectacle. Arrive well before.

spots.title: Kappabashi Street
spots.body: Knives and kitchenware. Many shops close 1 to 3 January for shogatsu, so go on the 30th or 31st.

legs.title: Tokyo to Hanoi
legs.body: Haneda or Narita to Noi Bai. Vietnam Airlines, VietJet, ANA and JAL all fly it. Take a morning departure. Vietnam is two hours behind Japan. Noi Bai to the centre is 45 minutes by car.

legs.title: Hanoi
legs.body: Cool and damp in January, 15 to 20 degrees, with the fine persistent drizzle locals call mua phun. Not beach weather, but it's the right weather for bun cha and hot pot and egg coffee in a cold city. Ninh Binh is a two hour drive if you want karst landscape without a boat.

stays.title: Capella Hanoi
stays.subtitle: Bensley, 1920s opera house theme
stays.body: Built as the backstage of an opera house. Every corridor is a set piece. Sun Group property, Bill Bensley design.

legs.title: Hanoi to Hoi An
legs.body: Hanoi to Da Nang by air, then car south to Hoi An.

legs.title: Hoi An
legs.body: The tail of the central wet season. 20 to 25 degrees, often grey, sea too rough to swim. The Old Town and the lanterns are unaffected. Hue is 2h30 by train over the Hai Van Pass if you want to add it, at the cost of a night here.

stays.title: Four Seasons Nam Hai
stays.subtitle: Beachfront villas with private pools
stays.body: Low and spare, the tonal opposite of Capella. Fifteen minutes to the Old Town. At its best in sunshine you may not get in early January.

legs.title: Da Nang to Saigon
legs.body: Tan Son Nhat to District 1 is 30 minutes.

legs.title: Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: Peak dry season, 25 to 32 and clear. This night exists because the VietJet Brisbane nonstop only leaves from Saigon. Rooftop drink and one good dinner.

stays.title: Park Hyatt Saigon
stays.subtitle: Facing the Opera House
stays.body: Best hotel in the city. Colonial white facade on Lam Son Square.

legs.title: Saigon to Brisbane
legs.body: VietJet, departs around 10:50 and lands Brisbane around 21:55 the same day. Five flights a week and 8 January 2027 is a Friday, which is a scheduled day. Confirm when booking.
